issues.description: The commented example in the template Main class calls farm.feed(), but the problem statement and the solution expect a method named feedAllAnimals() on Farm. This name/signature mismatch between the template's example usage and the specified API can confuse students about which method to implement or lead them to implement an unexpected method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template's commented example consistent with the specification: replace farm.feed() with farm.feedAllAnimals() in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java. Alternatively, if a shorter alias is desired, add a public feed() method in Farm that delegates to feedAllAnimals(), and update the problem statement to mention the alias.

issues.description: The problem statement and the solution refer to the farm-wide feeding operation as feedAllAnimals(), but the template's example usage (in the commented Main) calls farm.feed(). This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual operation can confuse students about which method to implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the problem statement and solution by updating the template Main to use farm.feedAllAnimals() in the example (or add a feed() delegating method in Farm that calls feedAllAnimals()). This makes the method name consistent across artifacts and reduces student confusion.
